svg.title: ExpandableText component — collapsed and expanded states
svg.desc: Two panels showing the shared ExpandableText component: collapsed at 5 lines with a down chevron, and expanded to full text with an up chevron, both in the Cinémathèque skin's muted grey body text.

text.tspan: This late-night session opens on a stripped-
down soundstage where the crew reassembles
after a six-month hiatus, picking up threads
from the archive's earlier volumes without
pausing to explain them to newcomers...
This late-night session opens on a stripped-
down soundstage where the crew reassembles
after a six-month hiatus, picking up threads
from the archive's earlier volumes without
pausing to explain them to newcomers. The
first act follows a slow build through
equipment checks and warm-up banter before
the tone shifts into something more
deliberate: a series of extended takes shot
in near-total silence, broken only by
ambient room tone and the occasional creak
of the rig...
Props: text (string), lines (4 | 5, default 5),
chevronLabel (string, for aria-label). Fixed
text-muted color, full container width.
